item.title: 'Worst Ever' COP Summit?
item.description: Is this the worst COP summit on record? Juan Carlos Beldsoe, a former White House climate adviser under Bill Clinton, described the process as labyrinthine and ultimately dispiriting. item.description: En las últimas semanas, La Paz y El Alto, ciudades bolivianas ubicadas a más de 3.600 metros sobre el nivel del mar, han registrado temperaturas inusualmente altas. Este fenómeno, vinculado al cambio climático, preocupa a científicos y ambientalistas por sus posibles efectos sobre los glaciares y ecosistemas de las cordilleras bolivianas. Los habitantes, acostumbrados a protegerse del frío con abrigos y prendas térmicas, ahora enfrentan un calor poco habitual. item.title: Fermi's 14-year all-sky map bridges astronomy's elusive 'MeV gap'
item.description: Gamma rays, the most high-energy type of electromagnetic radiation in the universe, have always had a blind spot. We've always had trouble measuring them in the "megaelectronvolt" (MeV) energy range, which astronomers have taken to calling the "MeV gap." But a new paper from an international group of scientists working with the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) Collaboration, recently published in The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, takes a stab at closing that gap by identifying 450 cosmic sources in the 20–200 MeV range, providing the clearest view of low-energy gamma rays ever. Fuente: Phys.org.
